errors.evidence: The pie chart contains five sectors, not six.

The description incorrectly lists "9.5%" as a category label, when it is the value for the category "Повече от 20%". It also incorrectly assigns the color blue ('синьо') to "Повече от 20%", when the corresponding slice is purple ('лилав').
The color of the slice for the "10-15%" category is orange, not yellow ('жълт').

errors.text_span: На сектора "23.8%" е посочен процентът вътре в сектора.
errors.evidence: This sentence is misleading as it implies that only the sector with the value 23.8% has its percentage shown inside. In fact, all five sectors have their percentage values labeled within them.

errors.text_span: Секторите са подредени визуално по низходящ размер, започвайки от "Повече от 20%" и завършвайки с "0-5%".
errors.evidence: The description of the ordering is incorrect. The slices are ordered from largest to smallest, which means they start with "0-5%" (33.3%) and end with "Повече от 20%" (9.5%). The machine description has the order completely reversed.

The description fails to state the percentage value for any of the categories (e.g., that the '0-5%' category accounts for 33.3% of responses). These values are the primary data presented in the chart.
The description does not mention that the data is based on '105 responses', information which is provided in the figure.
